en.cornerHint: Parking the pointer in the top-left corner for about 500 ms can refuse further input. Ordinary mouse movement does not stop control.
en.delayHint: Keep the indicator between consecutive actions. Range: 200–3000 ms.
en.indicatorHint: Show the screen-edge glow and banner. Esc remains available when the indicator is off.
en.intro: See when the agent controls your desktop. Press Esc to stop.
en.invalid: Use 1–120 characters on one line and an integer hide delay between 200 and 3000.
en.modeHint: Lite keeps common tools and loads others on demand. A mode change reloads tools after the current action finishes.
en.persistFailed: The host did not confirm the saved settings. Refresh and retry.
en.previewed: Preview requested; resume first if you previously stopped with Esc.
en.stopHint: Physical Esc keeps desktop input paused. Other mouse/keyboard input and agent-generated Esc do not stop control. Check the task before resuming.
en.title: Windows computer use
en.unavailable: Writable settings are unavailable. Open this page in your local DSH host.
